title: SkyPeak Lounge — Manila (MNL) Terminal 1
content: Located after immigration in Terminal 1, Gate 8 area. Open daily 5:00 AM to 12:00 AM. Capacity: 120 seats. Amenities: hot buffet (local and international cuisine refreshed every 4 hours), premium bar with cocktails, 6 shower suites, high-speed WiFi, business center with printing and scanning, quiet zone with recliners, kids play area, flight information displays, and charging stations at every seat. Complimentary for Business/First passengers and SkyPeak Rewards Gold/Platinum members. Day pass: $45.

title: SkyPeak First Lounge — Manila (MNL) Terminal 1
content: Exclusive lounge for First class passengers and SkyPeak Rewards Platinum members. Located after immigration in Terminal 1, near Gate 10. Open daily 6:00 AM to 11:00 PM. Capacity: 40 seats. Amenities: a la carte restaurant with chef-prepared meals, champagne bar, private suites for resting (up to 3 hours), luxury shower suites with premium toiletries, personal concierge service, private security screening, and limousine transfer to aircraft for First class departures. No day pass available.

title: SkyPeak Lounge — Singapore (SIN) Terminal 3
content: Located in Changi Airport Terminal 3 transit area, Level 3 near Gate B6. Open 24 hours. Capacity: 90 seats. Amenities: hot and cold buffet with Asian and Western options, noodle bar with made-to-order laksa and ramen, full bar, 4 shower suites, high-speed WiFi, quiet nap pods (30-minute reservations), business center, and panoramic runway views. Complimentary for Business/First passengers and SkyPeak Rewards Gold/Platinum members. Day pass: $45. Access also available via Priority Pass.

title: SkyPeak Lounge — Tokyo Narita (NRT) Terminal 2
content: Located in Narita Airport Terminal 2 satellite building, near Gate 67. Open daily 6:30 AM to 9:30 PM. Capacity: 60 seats. Amenities: Japanese breakfast set and bento boxes, sushi counter (lunch hours), sake and beer selection, 3 shower suites, high-speed WiFi, Japanese garden view seating, work desks with monitors, and international newspapers. Complimentary for Business/First passengers and SkyPeak Rewards Gold/Platinum members. Day pass: $45.

title: SkyPeak Lounge — Hong Kong (HKG) Terminal 1
content: Located near Gate 35 in the East Hall transit area. Open daily 5:30 AM to 11:00 PM. Capacity: 75 seats. Amenities: dim sum station, congee bar, Western buffet options, cocktail bar, 4 shower suites, high-speed WiFi, tarmac-view window seating, phone booths for private calls, massage chairs, and device charging stations. Complimentary for Business/First passengers and SkyPeak Rewards Gold/Platinum members. Day pass: $45.

title: SkyPeak Lounge — Los Angeles (LAX) Tom Bradley Terminal
content: Located in the Tom Bradley International Terminal (TBIT), after security near Gate 148. Open daily 6:00 AM to 11:00 PM. Capacity: 80 seats. Amenities: California-inspired buffet, fresh juice bar, premium wine and spirits, 5 shower suites, high-speed WiFi, outdoor terrace with runway views, work pods with USB-C and AC power, relaxation room with recliners, and complimentary magazines. Complimentary for Business/First passengers and SkyPeak Rewards Gold/Platinum members. Day pass: $50.
